mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.REG_CODE)) FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON(A.REG_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND A.hodeDate = B.HOLD_DATE AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02'))

SELECT tmp1.REG_CODE prdRegistCode, tmp1.VDATE prdVDate, tmp1.hodeDate, tmp1.RAISE_QTY prdRaiseTotalQty, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT prdRaiseTotalAmt, SUM(QTY) investRaiseTotalQty, SUM(CNY_AMT) investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT A.REG_CODE, A.VDATE, A.hodeDate, A.RAISE_QTY, A.TOTAL_AMT, B.QTY, B.CNY_AMT, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by A.REG_CODE , B.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY B.STATUS DESC,B.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) AS investStatusNo FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON (A.REG_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND A.hodeDate = B.HOLD_DATE AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02') ) ) tmp1 WHERE investStatusNo = 1 GROUP BY tmp1.REG_CODE, tmp1.VDATE, tmp1.hodeDate, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT
